experiment: two-source evidence synthesis and model-coupling pilot
task_type: evidence synthesis and verification, not discovery
evidence_scope: Only facts from the two open-access papers below and deterministic calculations from their published inputs. No private repository code, private prompts, credentials, or unpublished model outputs are included.

A_growth_rate_translation.question: A published post-ERK-peak cell-area slope is being considered for use in two 24 h update forms: linear A(t)/A(0)=1+k*t and exponential A(t)/A(0)=exp(k*t). Is the exponential form directly measured by the cited experiment, how do the two central 24 h factors compare, and what does the experiment report about periodic synchronous tissue-wide ERK activation? Choose a next action that preserves the source's uncertainty.

public_facts.measured_quantity: Average single-cell area normalized to its area at the ERK peak, as a function of time from the peak.
public_facts.reported_fit: The post-peak normalized-area slope is reported as a linear fit of 0.006 +/- 0.002 per hour, with a 68% confidence interval; 89 cells from 3 scales and 3 fish in one trial.
public_facts.synchrony_result: Daily synchronous, tissue-wide ERK activation in place of traveling waves was reported to impair scale tissue growth.
public_facts.scope_note: The source reports the empirical fit and its uncertainty; the two update equations in the question are candidate mathematical forms to compare.

shared_deterministic_tool_result.description: Deterministic arithmetic from the public paper's central slope, stated CI, and a 24 h interval. Rounded to the displayed precision.

B_fin_load_coupling.question: A modeler proposes turning a pressure p into a ray line-load q by multiplying by an effective width w. The dimensions are p in Pa and w in m. Does the cited zebrafish fin study validate calling q a measured in vivo ray load? State what the paper actually measured and choose a defensible next action.

public_facts.measured_result: The study reports in-vivo bending stiffness EI values in the approximate range 1.5e-9 to 4e-9 N m^2 along the proximal-distal axis.
public_facts.method: The investigators applied a calibrated mechanical force through a deflection pin and measured fin deflection; the force-deflection relation was used to determine bending stiffness.
public_facts.additional_context: The discussion identifies force extent over time and space and coupled elasto-hydrodynamic simulation as relevant to relating tissue mechanics to swimming.

shared_deterministic_tool_result.description: Dimensional multiplication only. It establishes unit compatibility and does not establish a measured biological mapping.

response_contract.format: one JSON object per call; no markdown fences
response_contract.source_ids: Use the two DOI strings as identifiers; explanations are optional and are not graded by a language model.
